title: DAC Accords Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for ₹52,000 Crore Capital Defence Acquisitions
summary: Clears Akash Tarang anti-UAV system, MPATGM, MRSAM, V-SHORADS, and FW-HAPS pseudo-satellite.

blocks.content: Clears Akash Tarang anti-UAV system, MPATGM, MRSAM, V-SHORADS, and FW-HAPS pseudo-satellite.

items: Army Cleared Systems (6): 'Akash Tarang' anti-UAV EW system, MPATGM, MRSAM, V-SHORADS, Active Protection System, jet Kamikaze drones.
Navy Approved Proposals (3): Multi Influence Ground Mine (MIGM), Naval Shipborne UAS (NSUAS), Land-Based Testing Facility (LBTF).
Air Force Approval: Fixed-Wing High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (FW-HAPS) operating at 18-20 km stratosphere altitude.
